Name: N.O.V.A. 3
Description: Gameloft's science-fiction shooter, the third Near Orbit Vanguard Alliance campaign, with vehicle sections and online deathmatch.

Achievements.Name: Full Armory
Achievements.Description: Wield 7 weapons in a match.

Achievements.Name: Slick
Achievements.Description: Capture 3 flags without dying in a match.

Achievements.Name: Stress Relief
Achievements.Description: Kill a sniper with a melee weapon.

Achievements.Name: Make It Count
Achievements.Description: Kill an enemy with your last bullet.

Achievements.Name: Against All Odds
Achievements.Description: Kill 5 enemies in a match while under 25% energy.

Achievements.Name: Five in a row
Achievements.Description: Win 5 consecutive matches

Achievements.Name: Fly Swatter
Achievements.Description: Kill a flying enemy.

Achievements.Name: Hijacked
Achievements.Description: Hijack a vehicle after killing its driver.

Achievements.Name: Star Player
Achievements.Description: Be the best player during a match.

Achievements.Name: Ghost in the Machine
Achievements.Description: Kill 10 enemies with the Mech.

Achievements.Name: Lightning Fast
Achievements.Description: Complete level 2 in under 20 minutes

Achievements.Name: Headhunter
Achievements.Description: Get 10 headshots with the sniper rifle in a Campaign level

Achievements.Name: Flawless
Achievements.Description: Complete a campaign level without ever retrying

Achievements.Name: Blind Shot
Achievements.Description: Kill one enemy with the sniper rifle without using the aim

Achievements.Name: Close Call
Achievements.Description: Have your HP reduced to less than 10%, avoid dying and recover to full HP

Achievements.Name: Bullseye
Achievements.Description: Finish a level with an accuracy higher than 60%

Achievements.Name: Lone Ranger
Achievements.Description: Complete an entire level using only the pistol

Achievements.Name: Collector
Achievements.Description: Buy all the upgrades available in the campaign mode

Achievements.Name: Versatile warrior
Achievements.Description: Kill at least one enemy with each weapon of the game in the same level

Achievements.Name: Humanity Saved
Achievements.Description: Complete the campaign mode
